chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a slim young Moroccan university student, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white drawstring and dark blue jeans
chars.ROOMMATE: ROOMMATE: a broad-shouldered young Moroccan man, buzz-cut black hair, thick dark eyebrows, short black beard, wearing a dark green tracksuit jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves and black tracksuit trousers

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark bedroom lit by blue moonlight from the window. ROOMMATE alone, seen from the waist up, standing beside a bed and looking down toward it, jaw clenched, teeth gritted, furious wild eyes. Only ROOMMATE in the picture, no other person. Thriller atmosphere, no gore.
